messages.author: daa74365023a9f1d
messages.subject: Problem with latest plyr version
parts:
Hello!

After updating my plyr package I have problems using the extractModelSummaries command. I get the following error message:
"Error: All inputs to rbind.fill must be data.frames."

Do anyone know of a way to get around this problem?

Thanks!
Martin

messages.author: 644e1c01c3c42210
messages.subject: Re: Problem with latest plyr version
parts:
Hi Martin,

Sorry for the incompatibility with the plyr 1.8 update. I have fixed the rbind.fill bug -- and made the code more intelligent to boot! :) Anyway, we'll include this in the next official MplusAutomation release, but for now you can install the development version (which includes the fix) here:

install.packages("MplusAutomation", repos="http://R-Forge.R-project.org")

It may take 24 hours for R-forge to build the new package, but adding type="source" to the install line above should pull the latest. Let me know if you have any problems getting the fixed version.

Best,
Michael
